hook: The Original Meaning of 'Spirit' Will Give You Chills

voices.name: l00
voices.text: Do you know what the word spirit <#0.2#> originally meant?
voices.caption: Do you know what the word spirit originally meant?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: It comes from the Latin spiritus. <#0.3#> And its meaning? <#0.5#> Breath.
voices.caption: From the Latin spiritus. Its meaning… breath.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: The Greek pneuma. <#0.2#> The Hebrew ruach. <#0.2#> The Sanskrit prana. <#0.3#> Every one of them means breath, <#0.2#> and spirit.
voices.caption: The Greek pneuma. The Hebrew ruach. The Sanskrit prana. Every one of them means breath, and spirit.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Civilizations that never met <#0.2#> all knew the same thing.
voices.caption: Civilizations that never met all knew the same thing.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Right now, in this very moment, <#0.2#> your spirit is moving in and out of you.
voices.caption: Right now, in this very moment, your spirit is moving in and out of you.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: Take one long, slow breath out. <#0.2#> Right now.
voices.caption: Take one long, slow breath out. Right now.
